summary: Mt. Hood NF site: 1915 rag camp, then a 1933 L-4 ground cabin; deactivated 1964 and removed or destroyed in 1967; no source describes the site now.

facts.design: L-4 ground cabin built 1933 (a 1959 entry calls the lookout a tower)
facts.status_note: Register says the lookout was removed in 1967; the Fire Lookout website says the cabin was destroyed in 1967
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (Mt. Hood National Forest)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the Fire Lookout website describe an L-4 ground cabin, but a 1959 entry quoted on Rex's page calls the lookout a tower with a catwalk. The story follows the ground-cabin description and reports the 1959 wording.

sources.title: Oak Grove Butte Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: Brief's 2010 registration date confirmed (September 19, 2010). Register says removed 1967; Fire Lookout website says destroyed 1967. Brief's county (Clackamas) is not stated on any page read, so the story omits it. The brief's 'ground' kind fits the register and Fire Lookout pages; the 1959 'tower' wording is the only conflict. No height or photos were found.
